newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Freeport says no immediate comment on Busang.
newsitem.headline: Freeport says no immediate comment on Busang.

text.p: PT Freeport Indonesia, the local affiliate of Freeport McMoRan Copper and Gold Inc, said on Monday it had no immediate comment on a report from Bre-X Minerals Ltd that Bre-X's gold claim was based on falsified data.
"We have no comment at this time but we hope to be releasing a statement later today," PT Freeport Indonesia spokesman Edward Pressman told Reuters.
Freeport McMoRan had taken a 15 percent stake in the Busang property in Indonesia's East Kalimantan province and had been designated to develop the property, dependent on a "due diligence" survey.

Bre-X, a small exploration company based in Calgary, Canada, released a report late on Sunday Canadian time from mining consultants Strathcona Mineral Services Ltd which said samples assayed to test the amount of gold at the site had produced no gold of economic interest.
Bre-X last month said it might have overestimated the amount of gold at Busang, originally estimated at almost 71 million ounces which would have been the biggest find of the century.
Bre-X has a 45 percent stake in Busang and Indonesian interests the remaining 40 percent.
